# Tether June 2025 reserve report dictionary

The detailed Financial Figures and Reserves Report is for Tether International, S.A. de C.V. at June 30, 2025, 11:59 p.m. UTC. Its listed asset categories are reserves backing fiat-denominated Tether tokens. The report says its financial information is extracted from accounting records and is not the company's financial statements. The report was approved July 31, 2025. Its historical publication timestamp is unknown. The separate official release is dated July 31, 2025, with publication time unknown.

The detailed schedule reports USD values by reserve asset category. The detailed company total-liabilities line is company-wide and is distinct from the report's token liability measure. The token liability footnote distinguishes gross contractual redemption and company-held tokens outside the Treasury wallet. The company-held amount is excluded from the report-defined issued-token liability. All liability inputs in this dossier refer to June 30, 2025.

`reserve_components` holds detailed USD reserve asset amounts. `liability_inputs` holds source amounts with distinct measures and scopes. The release's company-wide liability amount is a separate publication from the detailed report's amount. The detailed June report scope is the company named above. The December 2024 comparative is not used because it also includes Tether Limited.

## Source sections

b03:s01 - Detailed Financial Figures and Reserves Report, PDF page 6, printed page 1. The report covers Tether International, S.A. de C.V. on June 30, 2025 at 11:59 p.m. UTC. It was authorized and approved July 31, 2025.

b03:s02 - PDF page 9, printed page 4, detailed reserve asset categories in USD: U.S. Treasury Bills 105,518,993,610, Overnight Reverse Repo 16,341,965,339, Term Reverse Repo 1,666,870,344, Money Market Funds 6,345,999,587, Cash & Bank Deposits 32,430,726, Non-U.S. Treasury Bills 48,169,774, Corp Bonds 14,605,090, Precious Metals 8,725,417,224, Bitcoin 8,928,174,931, Other Investments 4,815,162,084, Secured Loans 10,137,145,089.

b03:s03 and b03:s04 - PDF page 8, printed page 3. The detailed report company total liabilities are USD 157,108,000,474. Gross contractual redemption is USD 157,571,645,333. Company-held tokens not in the Treasury wallet are USD 471,389,476 and are excluded from the net issued-token liability measure.

b03:s05 - Official issuer release, dated July 31, 2025. It reports June 30 company total liabilities of USD 157,108,009,474. Publication time is unknown.

b03:s06 - The detailed report describes accounting-record information and states that it is not the company financial statements. The December 2024 comparative also includes Tether Limited alongside the Company.
instruction: Using the June 30, 2025 detailed Financial Figures and Reserves Report and the issuer release, independently reconstruct `reserve_assets_usd` (USD) from the reserve asset line items. Derive `net_token_liability_usd` (USD) from the report-defined token liability inputs. Report `company_asset_excess_usd` (USD) as reconstructed reserve assets less detailed report company liabilities and `release_liability_delta_usd` (USD), oriented as release amount minus detailed report amount. Assess whether the two publications report the same exact June 30 company total liabilities.

answers.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS value FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-06-30'

SELECT (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure='gross contractual redemption') - (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure='company-held tokens not in Treasury wallet') AS value
SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-06-30') - (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure='detailed FFR company total liabilities') AS value

SELECT (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure='July release company total liabilities') - (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure='detailed FFR company total liabilities') AS value
